limits: No SDK, app, preview, observer, new render or screenshot command was executed. Only original screenshots were read and derived labeled contact sheets were made.
Bound qualitative judgments cover only baseline, expanded and submitted, independently for wrapping and overlap. Target-only state cells remain selected N/A for those atoms.
Blocked disabled observations did not successfully dispatch an activation; empty callback deltas do not prove handler behavior. Native disabled enablement is separately checked.
All fourteen iOS title-native-weight cells across P1/P2 remain unassessed because computed SwiftUI weight is unavailable from AX.
Original native callback/summary/selection/enablement results were preserved. Android activation is semantic Compose OnClick, not physical touch.
Grid-column findings are outside the selected ledger denominator; their seven state manifestations form one product root-cause cluster.
Color samples, expected values and pixel verdicts are unchanged tool outputs. No manual color measurement or expectation override was submitted.
Original plans, actions, source, bridges and public independent design remained unchanged.
No RTL, arbitrary incoming-data, idempotent reselect or all-unavailable case was newly run; only sealed P1/P2 evidence was reviewed.
